items.title: Researchers Null-Route Over 550 Kimwolf and Aisuru Botnet Command Servers
items.description: The Black Lotus Labs team at Lumen Technologies said it null-routed traffic to more than 550 command-and-control (C2) nodes associated with the AISURU/Kimwolf botnet since early October 2025.
